notes.title: Version 1.091 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello,

As is common in games, we managed fix one thing, and broke another. Hopefully this hotfix should resolve the issues a few users were seeing, along with a few other minor improvements.

[list]
[*] [b]Calendar[/b] - The calendar screen will no longer freeze when selecting the tutorial for party invitations
[*] [b]Incidents[/b] - Fixed reward and credibility check issues in the incidents 'Fishy Business', 'Some Light Reading', and 'Wise Investments'
[*] [b]Incidents[/b] - Fixed the missing tooltip text in 'Courting Disaster'
[*] [b]Incidents[/b] - Fixed several French misspellings throughout the game
[/list]

Thanks again for your continued support,

- Luther

notes.title: Version 1.09 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] [b]Content[/b] - 10 New finalized party incidents are now added to chapter 2!
[*] [b]Calendar[/b] - It's no longer possible to have three invitations on the same day
[*] [b]Incidents[/b] - Incident updates and typo fixes
[/list]

This update finalizes some additional party incidents that we wanted to add to chapter 2, just to give our players a little extra variety. A few astute players have already ran into unfinished versions of those incidents, so this should fix those up for them. 

As always, thanks so much for your support!

notes.title: Version 1.08 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] [b]UI[/b] - Future saved games will no longer include Yvette's name in the title. Older game saves will be unaffected by this change.
[*] [b]Stability[/b] - Minor improvement to the stability of the save system
[*] [b]Stability[/b] - Fixed several rare crash issues that would occur in various incidents
[*] [b]Incidents[/b] - Incident updates and typo fixes
[/list]

This is another small update which fixes some issues we noticed while plugging away on the upcoming Nintendo Switch Port. So glad to see so many people are enjoying the game!

notes.title: Version 1.07
notes.notes:
[list]
[*][b] Save System[/b] - Saving the game during the introductory incident, then trying to load that incident will no longer cause freezes
[*] [b]Incidents[/b] - Fixed issues with rewards in the incident 'Old Connections'
[*] [b]Historical Accuracy[/b] - Removed all references to arrondisemenmts, as those weren't established until 1795.
[*] [b]General[/b] - Various incident updates and fixes
[/list]

This update is relatively small, as we're mainly focused on implementing proper controller support, and working on the Nintendo Switch Port of the game.

notes.title: Version 1.06 Update
notes.notes:
- [b]Steam[/b] - 20 Steam Achievements have been added to the game!
- [b]Paris Map[/b] - If you intitiate certain story events with Cafe Principe or La Place Royale before visiting those locations for the first time, their intro incidents will integrate this information more smoothly.
- [b]Cafe Principe[/b] - Fixed an issue where, sometimes, visits to Cafe Principe randomly ended early.
- [b]Story[/b] - Fixed an issue where, sometimes, the Epilogue ended early during Alex's segment.

As a general note, past play throughs will not be counted in unlocking of achievments, as that data was never being tracked up until this point. We apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Version 1.05 Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] [b]Parties[/b] - Gifting wine to the host of a party will no longer cause a random peril increase
[*] [b]Story[/b] - Five brand new random political incidents have been added to Chapter 2!
[*] [b]General[/b] - Various incident and typo fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.04 Update
notes.notes:
- Save System - Added the ability to overwrite existing saves.
- Save System - Limited the maximum amount of possible player saves to 40, to preserve system stability. This should also prevent new cases of the error that caused some players to be unable to load their saves.
- Servants - Added several more servant interactions to various incidents throughout the game, to improve their usefulness.
- Story - Enhanced several sections in the epilogue related to Armand and his... plans.
- General - In the case of certain errors, the game will give you the ability to email your save data to customer support so we can help you more directly.
- General - Typos and minor animation fixes.

To go into the saves issue a little bit more: When we first designed the save system, we didn't put a limit on the amount of saves that players could have. However, it appears that we [b]seriously underestimated[/b] the amount of separate save files some players would have. Once players started getting into the area of 300+ save files, issues started appearing with our game's ability to properly create and maintain the integrity of the file. This sometimes manifested as players being unable to load their saves at all, as the game was trying to load corrupted data. To that end, we've limited the amount of separate saves a player can have at any one time to 40 (not including the autosave), which is still a lot of files.

Any players who have more than 40 saves will be prompted to delete some of their saves before they can make any new save files. We're really sorry about any inconvenience this might cause, but it's turned out to be necessary to prevent file corruption, and potential loss of game progress (which is something we clearly have to place a high priority on preventing). 

Thanks again for your patience and support!

- Luther

notes.title: Version 1.03 Update
notes.notes:
- System - Fixed the edge case where, in some cases, players stopped receiving party invitations at the end of Chapter 1. Previously broken saves suffering this bug should now also be fixed!
- Art - Fixed a framing issue with Thomas unique art in 'The First Sparks'
- Rendezvous - Fixed an issue with floating empty choices in Elisabeth's rendezvous incident
- General - Various typo fixes

notes.title: Patch: Version 1.02
notes.notes:
- [b]General[/b] - Increased max framerate to 60, improving the smoothness of animations, while preventing the game from consuming too many resources
- [b]Story[/b] - The player will no longer be able to turn down the parties necessary to complete their revenge on villains in chapter 1, ensuring they can have the last laugh without being undone by a mere scheduling conflict
- [b]Epilogue[/b] - Cleaned up some issues with Alex's segment of the Epilogue that, in some cases, caused the sequences to end early
- [b]Incidents[/b] - Fixed a situation in 'A Fabric Shortage' that caused the incident to end early
- [b]Incidents[/b] - Various typo and animation fixes

notes.title: An exciting update on Ambition: A Minuet in Power
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Hope you're all doing well. It's been a while since our last update. We've been working hard to bring [i]Ambition: A Minuet in Power[/i] to you later this year, and we're excited to announce that we now have a new partner to help us get through these final stretches of development.

We've signed with Iceberg Interactive, an indie game publisher who can help us with all sorts of stuff like marketing and Q&A so that we can focus on... well, developing the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35781097/30938e5ef8a08eab30928f13805aeb28fb5c6ea3.jpg[/img]

And that's not all! Our incredible composer, John Robert Matz, has shared an exclusive song from the official Ambition soundtrack. Need more classical music in your life? We've got you covered, just [url=https://soundcloud.com/john-robert-matz/ambition-a-minuet-in-power-suite-vaticana-ii-giga]click here[/url] to listen!

You'll be hearing more from us Soon™, we're working on some very exciting things. We can't wait to show you the next big step in Ambition's development!

Speaking of, the best place to stay informed and up to date is the official Ambition Discord Server!
